To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
snow line is close to the maximum elevation of a basin in snow poor winters, but is equal or below the minimum elevation in snow rich years.
the snow cover starts in December and lasts to February/March in most basins.

the snow cover in the highest basinsk (Poprad, Hornád, Upper Váh and Hron) starts in December and lasts until April, the mean snow cover area is around 70% of the basin area, snowmelt lasts about two months and the snow depletion curves are quite variable between the winters.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the snow line elevation, area and depletion in Slovak basins.
the variability in the snow line elevation, seasonal snow cover and snow depletion in the Slovak main basins.
the variability in the SL, SCA and SCD in ten main Slovak basins.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the winter snow cover variability in the Carpathians is high, and the variability is much higher between the winters than between the bas-ins. Variability
the snow cover in Slovakia in winters 2002–2014 is not decreasing, but the variability of SCA is increasing.
snow cover in the Slovak basins is not stable and that the snow cover is highly variable in space and time, even within the individual basins.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
there is no simple relationship between the snow line elevation and the snow cover area in the Slovak river basins.
the snow line elevation and the depletion of snow cover are the most important indicators of snow cover in the Slovak basins.
snow cover in the Western Carpathians is very variable and that it is difficult to generalize about snow cover evolution in this area.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the snow cover is highly variable between the years in Slovakia.
the snow cover in the Slovak Carpathians has a significant variability in time and space.
the variability in snow cover in the Slovak basins is very large, even in the same basins.
